title: Xdrip+ and G6 "stopped"
symptom: Sensor stopped working overnight, transmitter voltage dropped at 61 days, sensor 4 days old. xDrip shows 'not connected' and is stuck trying to hard reset transmitter. User is unsure if it's a Bluetooth, sensor, or transmitter problem.
fix: Call Dexcom to claim the transmitter and receive a new one.
evidence_quote: Sometimes the transmitter batteries don't last the full time. I think that is what has happened here.
